sentences.text: Mr. Anjan Bhattacharya Ms. Anita Shaw Ms. Seema Thakur ...for the Petitioner Supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioner is taken on record.

The petitioner herein has prayed for quashing of the proceeding being G.R. case no. 26 of 2022,
presently pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore under Section 419/420/468/120B of the IPC.
The allegation against the petitioner is that on 2nd January, 2022 somebody appeared in place of the present petitioner in the examination for the recruitment to the post of Excise Constable conducted by the Government of West Bengal.
After completion of investigation, police has submitted charge-sheet.

Being aggrieved by the aforesaid proceeding, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegations brought against the petitioner are false and causing unnecessary harassment to the petitioner.

He further submits that the petitioner has already been selected in the written test for the post of constable but due to pendency of the instant proceeding, he is not in a position to join that post.

He further submits that the facts as described in the complaint at best, gives rise to a civil claim but does not attract criminality and as such, continuance of further proceeding against the present petitioner will be mere abuse of process of the court.
Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner, the application is admitted.

is directed to serve a copy of the application upon the State through the office of Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no. 2 by speed post intimating the next date of hearing and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

Let the matter appear on 25th March, 2026 at 2 P.M. under the heading "Contested Application"
within 1st ten items of the day's list.

(Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
